WordPress theme design continuity, may include search widget

best_practices.description: Keep main navigation visible so users can easily redirect
Obvious 'Back to Home' or 'Contact Us' button
Match tone of rest of site (friendly, professional, humorous as appropriate)
Phone number, email, or contact form link on 404 page
Search bar helps users find what they're looking for
Links to popular pages: Menu, Gallery, Contact, About
Creative illustration, photo, or animation makes 404 memorable
Analytics tracking on 404 pages to find broken links/sources
Return actual 404 status code, not 200 with 404 content
best_practices.detected_issue: Some SPA/routing sites return 200 for all routes

humorous_approaches: 'Even our chefs can't find this recipe...'
'This table seems to be reserved for someone else...'
helpful_approaches: Popular pages grid (Menu, Gallery, Contact, About)
Contact form mini-widget ('Need help finding something?')
Site map links organized by category
visual_approaches: Food photography collage with missing piece
conversion_focused: Special offer banner ('Lost? Here's 10% off for your trouble')
Lead capture form ('Tell us what you were looking for')
Phone callback request ('We'll call to help you navigate')

cms_specific_behaviors.squarespace: Provides built-in 404 page editor; can customize fully; redirects /404 path appropriately
cms_specific_behaviors.wix: Default branded 404; customization limited without code injection; returns proper 404 status
cms_specific_behaviors.wordpress: Depends on theme; many have 404.php template; can create custom 404 page
cms_specific_behaviors.webflow: Full control over 404 page design; can add interactions/animations like any other page
cms_specific_behaviors.custom/spa: Must implement client-side routing 404 handling; ensure server returns 404 for crawlers

seo_considerations: Include noindex meta tag to prevent indexing
Add helpful internal links for crawl budget efficiency
Monitor Google Search Console for 404 reports
Set up custom redirect for high-traffic 404 URLs
